note: Frozen display-ready English messages. The backend returns exactly these texts, and the frontend mock must return the same. The frontend relies on field and code, and shows message as-is.

$.invalid_type: Request body must be a JSON object.

description.too_short: Description must be at least 3 characters.
description.too_long: Description must be at most 500 characters.

quantity.invalid_type: Quantity must be a whole number.

unit_price.invalid_type: Unit price must be text such as "249.90".
unit_price.invalid_format: Unit price must be a positive amount with at most 2 decimal places, for example "249.90".
unit_price.out_of_range: Unit price must be greater than 0 and at most 10000000.00.

currency.invalid_choice: Currency must be one of: EUR, USD, GBP, CHF.

requester_display_name.invalid_type: Requester display name must be text.
requester_display_name.too_short: Requester display name must be at least 2 characters.
requester_display_name.too_long: Requester display name must be at most 80 characters.

unknown_field_message: Unknown field. This field is not allowed.
